reviews.title: Staggeringly unintuitive, and difficult to use.
reviews.text:
This review is going to be difficult to write. I’ve worked with Adobe products for most of my professional life…more than 30 years.

No doubt about it. There are some things in this app that are impressive. It is a powerful tool.

But if you have to use it for any length of time, you will wind up feeling like a candidate for therapy… meaning that it’ll drive you crazy.

For example, font size of the words and icons that you lay over on a photo.

Determining the size of that font should be pretty easy, right?

Wrong.

It’s actually pretty difficult to find.

I could go on and on about small features like this that they just get horribly wrong.

I won’t go so far to say you should not buy this app, but I will say if you do… “pack a lot of patience” because you are going to need it.

reviews.title: A mediocre app has gone even more downhill.
reviews.text: This app has gotten worse progressively. Initially it was a free app and was great for what it was. Then it began applying a watermark to all saved pictures unless you upgrade to the pay option. I like the app enough to upgrade to the pay option to avoid the watermark. Now a new thing started happening where every time I save a picture a bubble pops up that says “applying content credentials.” This bubble stays on the screen sometimes for a few seconds, which when editing a large number of pictures significantly adds to the time it takes to do this. I’ve googled, asked AI, asked the Adobe help (which just told me I should ask someone else), and all of these sources either do not have a solution or they guide me to a solution that does not exist, example: telling me to deselect certain features in “preferences” that do not even exist when I go into preferences. I would gladly switch to another app but I’ve paid for the whole year for this one and I can’t speak to a live person to get my money back so I’m trying to find a solution to this issue. Other than this, other issues include the fact that you can only edit one picture at a time, rather than being able to apply the same edit or theme to multiple pictures at once as you can in actual Photoshop. Another issue is if I’m editing several pictures in a row it starts to really slow down and freeze up and make my phone overheat to the point where I then have to force close the app and go all the way back in. reviews.title: Adobe Refuses to repair Photoshop Express
reviews.text:
After numerous logging of issues such as the new inability to edit RAW imagery by premium subscribers, the prohibition of watermarks on imagery where object removal us utilized and the consistent, request for information regarding the cameras, versions of app, platforms the app is being utilized on & instructed reporting recommendations to the community boards, Adobe flat out will not repair the issues. 
     Unfortunately they will still auto debit from your account for the services they no longer provide.
     Sadly the investors into Adobe such as BlakRock Inc, Vanguard Capitol Management LLC, State Street Corporation, Invesco Ltd, Geode Capital Management LLC andArrowstreet Capital LP. All are unaware of the lack of functional action Adobe provides its clients. Is that the type of reputation an investor truly feels safe investing in?
     Definitely research other options regarding photography editing software as you will become disappointed over time as many have. 
     Don’t take my word for it, read the reviews, read the Adobe community boards and you will see more than enough to form your own decision.

reviews.title: Constantly Loading
reviews.text:
Since I renewed my annual Premium subscription (and after receiving an e-mail to say that I had renewed successfully), I have almost consistently had the small circle showing on the app Home Screen to show that something is loading, and whilst this symbol is there, I cannot do anything with the app.
I loaded the app onto my second (new 2026) iPad this week and that too constantly shows the loading symbol so I cannot use the app on that iPad either. The second iPad app has been “loading” for four days now and it doesn’t ever cease.
With my original iPad, on which the app worked perfectly for a year, I occasionally open the app and find the loading symbol has disappeared allowing me to use it and edit a couple of photos but this is maybe once a day. The next time I open it, everything is locked out again with the loading symbol going round and round (as it has been doing all of this morning).
As it seems impossible to contact anyone in customer support to get help I have had to resort to putting my request here in public.
Can someone please help?
